evidence: Specifically, the metal β-diketonate precursors, tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato) yttrium and tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato) manganese (Y(TMHD)3 and Mn(TMHD)3 respectively), were used as the precursors for Y and Mn. For the oxidant, oxygen atoms were generated from a coaxial waveguide microwave source, which was operated at 0.6 sccm O2 flow rate and 30-W microwave power.
